mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (login_id, nickname, password_hash, status) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{nickname}, #{passwordHash}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id, nickname, password_hash, status, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, login_id, nickname, password_hash, status, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE nickname = #{nickname}
